patch.summary: Sentry cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Sentry pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Developer. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Trial/free path present in researched plans

blocks.heading: Sentry cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Sentry against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Developer until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, infrastructure monitoring, APM and distributed tracing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Application teams whose primary observability job is errors, traces, and replays requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job
Side-by-side cost with Datadog on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Prepaid event volume on Team/Business is the TCO lever beyond list price stickers

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not on-call paging as a primary product (landscape vs PagerDuty)

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, git host, hosting panel, or managed hosting

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Sentry on identical constraints.

blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Sentry alongside category cost modelling.
